name: ME Dubai
positioning: Design hotel by Zaha Hadid inside The Opus building in Business Bay, Dubai, with a rooftop pool and Burj Khalifa views from some rooms
best_for: Travelers who want to stay inside a Zaha Hadid building
City stays with a view of the Burj Khalifa

facts.text: ME Dubai is set inside The Opus building in Business Bay, Dubai.
There is a focus on art and curated exhibitions alongside furniture designed by Hadid.
The rooms come in two distinct themes: one avant-garde and cosmopolitan, inspired by the city's nightlife, the other warmer and evocative of the desert around Dubai.
Corner suites have two connecting bedrooms, views of the Burj Khalifa, a large Jacuzzi in the bathroom and a double rainshower.
ME+ suites include private check-in and a direct line to the Aura team for reservations.
The spa offers a wide range of massages and treatments.
The Health Club gym has views of the city and the pool, with personal training and fitness classes.
Roka serves Japanese cuisine from the robata grill.
The hotel is across the street from the Dubai Canal's waterfront promenade.
The hotel has a pet programme for dogs with no weight limit.

highlights.text: ME Dubai was designed by the architect Zaha Hadid.
Every curved glass panel of the building's undulating void is unique.
The rooftop pool has views of Dubai's skyline.
Some rooms and suites look out on the Burj Khalifa.
ME+ suite guests can book experiences such as a cocktail workshop with the mixologist or a guided tour of the hotel's architecture.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the immediate area is a bit quiet and still being developed.
Conde Nast Traveler advises booking an east-facing room for a Burj Khalifa view.
WhataHotel notes a party-focused atmosphere that may not suit all travelers.
